scope: driver-visible circuit scenery, cockpit and exterior cameras

references.role: pit architecture, grid, barriers, grandstands, woodland
references.use: visual reference only, not a game texture; not copied to docs/vendor

references.title: The Fastest Lap In F1 History: Max Verstappen’s Pole Lap | 2025 Italian Grand Prix | Pirelli
references.use: inspected in browser; video not redistributed

jobs.prompt: One mature European hornbeam tree from the Royal Park of Monza, Italy. Photorealistic summer deciduous tree, 16 metres tall, single grey-brown branching trunk, clear lower trunk 4 metres, irregular spreading airy crown of many small olive green leaves, visible fine branches, natural asymmetry. Complete isolated tree from roots to crown. No ground, no pot, no pedestal, no people or buildings. Realistic PBR bark and foliage, neutral diffuse lighting. Game environment asset seen at roadside from a racing cockpit.
jobs.note: Studio showed Geometry & Texture, but exported GLB has no texture maps. Do not claim textured output. No paid retries, texture or retopology jobs submitted.

derivatives.colour: local vertex colours, not generated PBR maps
derivatives.integration: vendor/monza-tree.js; runtime leaf sprays and crossed woodland impostors in src/game.js

limitations: Existing flat OSM-derived centreline retained; no LiDAR or surveyed elevation/width data.
Architecture, dimensions, bridge locations and sponsor placements are visual approximations.
One generated tree source, with local colour and leaf sprays; botanical variety remains limited.
Off-track buildings have visual geometry only; gameplay collision remains the circuit barrier.
Physical wheel feel and real-GPU performance are not established by screenshots.

browser.limits: posed checks only; no sustained frame-time benchmark
browser.performance_note: Automated HUD FPS was unstable, including the unchanged Kestrel baseline. Added spatial woodland culling and leaf/shadow distance limits; no controlled sustained frame-time benchmark.

checks.delivery: local build in docs/ and Design copies; not publicly deployed
